```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(srvyr)
```

```{r Survey Data Setup}
rhfs <- read.csv("RHFS_2024_Public_Variables.csv")

df <- rhfs |> 
  select(-REPWGT0) |> # REPWGT0 is equivalent to WEIGHT
  as_survey_rep(
    repweights = starts_with("REPWGT"), 
    weights = WEIGHT, 
    type = "successive-difference", 
    combined_weights = TRUE, 
    # Decided to set to T to follow SDR as outlined by Ash (to match what was done in Census's Methodology)
    mse = TRUE
  )

# Sanity check against Table 5 of Census's Methodology
df |> 
  summarize(
    properties = survey_total(vartype = "se") # Applies weights and calculates se of properties
  ) |> 
  mutate( # Dividing by 1000 to match Table 5's scale
    properties = properties / 1000, 
    properties_se = properties_se / 1000, 
    moe = properties_se * 1.645 # 90% margin of error
  )
```

```{r EDA}
# No explicit NAs
sum(is.na(df))
```
